title: Lead generation campaign reset

intent.problem: Campaign activity is high but qualified lead volume is flat
intent.desired_outcome: Increase qualified lead volume with measurable channel and message tests

constraints: sales qualification definition must remain unchanged

facts: Qualified lead volume is the business outcome
assumptions: Message-market mismatch is a plausible contributor

decisions.decision: Use qualified leads as primary campaign decision metric
decisions.rationale: It is closer to the business outcome than click volume

workstreams.name: Offer and message tests
workstreams.outcome: Identify combinations that increase qualified response

risks: Sales follow-up differences could confound lead quality

domain_data.measurement: qualified lead volume and lead-to-opportunity rate

success_criteria: Every test has a decision rule before launch
Qualified lead tracking is reconciled with sales data

next_action: Audit campaign-to-CRM qualified lead mapping before drafting new creative
